title: Finite-dimensional embeddings of doubling Hilbert subsets
exact_target: Suppose a metric space $X$ is doubling, meaning that every ball can be covered by a fixed finite number of balls of half its radius. If $X$ admits a bi-Lipschitz embedding into a Hilbert space, must it admit a bi-Lipschitz embedding into $\mathbb R^m$ for some finite $m$?
